prompt: How is the federal government actually doing on Section 508 compliance? Give me the latest numbers.
assertions: Cites the FY2025 governmentwide Section 508 assessment, announced March 5, 2026
States the average conformance score: 1.96 on a 5-point scale
States fewer than half of agencies' most-viewed ICT is fully conformant and about half of agencies do not routinely test ICT
States under 30 percent of agencies almost always verify ICT deliverables in acquisition, across 212 reporting agencies and components
Notes no FY2026 assessment has been published yet
